gloss: prominent, leading, one of the best

definitions.gloss: prominent, leading, one of the best, top-ranking
definitions.explanation: Being counted among the very best or most notable in a given category. Implies that something or someone ranks highly among peers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大企業|だいきぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is one of the world's leading corporations.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉地|おんせんち}→温泉地：28309_onsenchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This place is known as one of Japan's top hot spring areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧な⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}している→生産する：01841_seisansuru⟧。
examples.english: This region is one of the country's leading rice-producing areas, producing high-quality rice every year.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used in the pattern 「Scope + {有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + Noun」: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (one of the world's top), ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (one of Japan's leading), ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (one of the nation's top). Literally means "countable among" — i.e., so prominent that it can be counted among the best.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: one of the world's leading
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: one of Japan's top
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧{有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: one of the country's leading
- {有数|ゆうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: a leading company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屈指|くっし}→屈指：12367_kusshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: one of the best, top-ranking (similar meaning and pattern)
- ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧: first-rate, top-class
